generatedProse.practice-connection:
You have met structured reflection, the move from describing to reflecting, and the turn from reflection to action, as one practice. The place to use it is the work in front of you: the next assignment returned with feedback, the next project that does not go to plan, the next piece you want to be better than the last. Pick one real experience and take it through the cycle this week.

The habit travels with you. In any job you will be given work, measured against a standard, and asked to improve, and structured reflection is how people turn that cycle into steady progress rather than repeated mistakes. What you have practised here on your studies is the same practice you will lean on at work.
